title: The spec gate race test expects gate-not-passed for any decision ordered before the authorization, although an approval may leave a valid grant
resolution: Section 7 separates the approval race, whose launch may be granted and is not revoked, from the race of a passed gate made stale; the spec delta adds an approval scenario

title: The spec scenario and section 4.1 reopen a passed gate directly, which the gate transitions forbid
resolution: Contract sections 4.1 and 6.3 and the spec delta name the path passed to stale to pending and revoke in the transaction that makes the gate stale

title: The standing rule use race is stated in commit order, not in serialization order
resolution: Section 7 and the two use scenarios say serialized before, regardless of which transaction commits first

title: The race tests omit the artifact revision and policy revision writers, bulk invalidation, and grant revocation by a policy change, and mix the running attempt case in
resolution: Section 7 has one race per bound writer with predicate, reason, empty read, and retry, the policy writer with several attempts, and a separate running attempt test

title: Design D1 attributes both helpers' calls to the worker revocation and the conformance calls to reopenGate
resolution: D1 names the actual callers of each helper and gate function; the conclusion that no G2 writer exists stands

title: The record says the dev merge brought only an archive, although it also changed two qualification documents
resolution: The Revision section names both qualification documents and states they are no inputs of the change

title: A return to Specify is said to make passed spec gates stale, although a gate goes stale only with a revision that outdates it
resolution: Section 6.3, the spec delta, and design D2 make the gate stale in the transaction that records the new revision; a return without a new revision cancels the active attempt by assignment with attempt-not-launchable

title: The new artifact revision writer does not update the run's current revision, which the authority compares and which only a G3 writer can extend
resolution: Section 6.3 and the requirement update the current revision through CurrentRevisions in the same transaction, which its first writer extends; the artifact race test asserts it

title: Plan item 44 re-admits only an attempt rejected under a stale admission, not one whose grant a product writer revoked
resolution: G3 plan item 44 now also re-admits a task whose grant a product writer revoked; plan amendment by the owner's away delegate, pending owner confirmation

title: Section 5 says a rule change revokes no grant, while design D2 leaves open whether it changes the policy revision
resolution: Section 5 revokes no grant unless the rule change changes the run's policy revision, and D2 says the same

title: The policy revision race test has no owning item, because no G3 item changes a run's immutable policy revision
resolution: Section 7, D5, and the proposal assign the test to the item that adds a command that changes the run's policy revision

title: The writer requirement omits reopening and its comma list is ambiguous
resolution: The requirement names every transaction that changes a spec gate's state, a decision, making a passed gate stale, and reopening

title: The use check says the attempt was dispatched under a generation, although ownership advances on each placement
resolution: Section 5 and the requirement compare the task's ownership generation with the request's assignment and its admission with the one the assignment names

title: The use requirement has no scenarios for a policy revision change or an ownership change
resolution: The spec delta adds the scenarios Use after a policy revision change and Use after an ownership change, in serialization order

title: Design D3 cites launch authorization section 5 for the kept ownership, which section 4 states
resolution: D3 cites launch authorization section 4 at line 50 and task.ts lines 120 and 121

title: The proposal still describes section 4.1 as deciding a spec approval or reopening its gate
resolution: The proposal lists every spec gate state change and the other revised sections

title: The pass 1 M3 line names the first fix commit, the record says make verify is the coordinator's, and the remaining gates still name pass 1
resolution: The M3 line names 19cbad02, the record says the worker runs make verify, and the remaining gates name pass 3
